CSS Styling Links

HTML links can be styled with many CSS properties, like

color
,

text-decoration
,

background-color
,

font-size
,

font-weight
,

font-family
, etc.).

Styling Links Depending on State

In addition, links can be styled differently depending on what
state
they are in.

The four link states are:

:link
- a normal, unvisited link

:visited
- a link the user has visited

:hover
- a link when the user mouses over it

:active
- a link the moment it is clicked

When setting the style for link states, there are some order rules:

:hover must come after :link and :visited

:active must come after :hover
